Our Story

Miles, Meals & Memories

Fueled by the passion of Basant, The Bikers Café brings the spirit of the ride together with three signature loves — Woodfire Pizza, Fresh Sushi and Artisan Ice Cream.

It is a place where riders, food lovers and families come together for a great time. From handcrafted coffees to woodfire pizzas and signature grills, every dish is prepared with premium ingredients and bold flavors.

Specializing in continental delights and authentic Chinese flavors, it’s the kind of pit stop where every appetite finds its road. Whether you walk in or ride in, every visit is a journey worth remembering.
